items.title: Pushback that is based on something
items.body: The host's hardest model test is whether it disagrees for a reason. For clinical reasoning that is the right test: ask a tool to critique a differential, not confirm it. A tool that agrees with everything is a liability in medicine.

items.title: Two models checking each other
items.body: For high-stakes research he has two different models grade each other's work. The same idea suits clinical documents: where an error would matter, a second independent check, whether a second model or a second clinician, catches mistakes a single pass misses. It does not replace the clinician.

items.title: Personal agents and the starred-email problem
items.body: Duet's best use was drafting replies to emails he would otherwise return to days later. In practice, similar tools could help with routine administrative correspondence, but only after a data protection assessment, because they read the mailbox. Patient information should not go through a personal agent.
